<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def balls(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['color'] in 'WOGp' and 8<=n['pixels']<=60:
            out[n['color']]=((min(rs)+max(rs))//2,(min(cs)+max(cs))//2)
    return out
print("BEFORE:",balls(current_frame))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':30,'col':48}])
print("after (30,48):",balls(current_frame), "changed:",last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
